turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: So what brings you in here today?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Hi, um so I've been very I've been, I haven't been feeling very well for the past four days. I've, I've been having chills. I am feeling short of breath and now my chest hurts.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, I'm sorry. Um so how long, like can you just tell me what started first and when did this all kind of start?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: So, what started first? So, I would say the shortness of breath started first, um, and then I started having these chills and now it hurts like my chest hurts every time I try to take, try to take a deep breath in.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And how long is this been going on for?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, it's been going on for the past four days.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Four days, okay. Um, and do you have any kind of cough at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No cough.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, so just shortness of breath. And can you describe your shortness of breath a little bit? Is it uh, are you having catching your breath, or would you say you're having trouble taking deep breaths? Or how would you describe it?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: It's mostly when I'm trying to take a deep breath in.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, and uh, where would you say you're getting the chest pain?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, it's mostly like centre of my chest, like, close to my, like I'd say it's like it feels like, it's not my like, it doesn't feel like it's inside. It feels more like it's pushing up on, on my chest wall.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, I see. And is it related to you taking deep breaths at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yes, it's definitely when I take a deep breath in.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, and what kind of pain is it? Is it like a sharp pain, stabbing pain, aching pain? How would you describe it?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, it's a, it's, it's like a, I don't know. I guess it's a sharp pain when I try to take a deep breath in.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, um, and does it get relieved with uh, when you when you expire?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, and have you had any of these symptoms before in the past?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, nothing like this.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. Um, would you say like, your symptoms are constant, or do they kind of come and go?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, they're pretty constant.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. And are they getting worse at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no it's not getting worse, it was just bad to start with and it's still bad.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, and um, is there anything that you've tried that helps you with your breathing or relieves your chest pain? Anything that works for you?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um I guess sitting forward helps. Time now to take a super deep breath in.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, and have you had any kind of fevers or chills?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, yeah, I've, I've had chills for sure. I felt hot. I haven't actually taken my temperature, so I'm not too sure about if I actually have a fever.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, and when did you feel these chills?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: They've been going on for the past three days.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. Uh, and do you have any kind of other symptoms, like runny nose, sore throat, anything like that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh maybe like a slight runny nose, yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, and do you get short of breath when laying down at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, I, no, not no, I wouldn't say so.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, and do you have to wake up at night to catch your breath at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, and do you have any kind of swelling in your legs, hands, anywhere?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. Have you experienced any kind of um dizziness or fainting episodes?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, do you get any kind of chest pain with any activities?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, not really. I guess it's, I get tired with the shortness of breath.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And do you, um, find that your heart is racing at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no, nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Are you having any night sweats?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Um, have you had any sick contacts recently?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, I guess when I went to the grocery store the other day and there were people coughing around me.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, and were they wearing masks or were you wearing a mask?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, everyone was wearing a mask.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. Are you um, having any kind of changes in your bowel movements at all? Any constipation or diarrhea?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No, okay. Any changes in your appetite at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No. Any nausea or vomiting?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. Any changes in your urinary pattern?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, any changes in your weight recently? Have you lost any significant weight?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No, okay. Have you recently had a cold, like cold-like symptoms at all within the last few weeks?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, yeah, I guess the runny nose. Um, I've had on and off for the past like 7 days.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, now, it hasn't gone away?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, it's not that bothersome though. It's more the chills and the shortness of breath, and this chest pain now that is worrying me.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, and do you have any past medical conditions or diagnoses?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um I was diagnosed with diabetes, um high blood pressure and high cholesterol.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, and when were you diagnosed with diabetes?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I was diagnosed about 10 years ago.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. Um, I'm sorry I forgot to ask you this specifically, have you experienced any kind of loss of your sense of taste or smell?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No, okay. Um do you take any medications for your medical conditions?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, medications. So I take, so, for the diabetes I take insulin. For the high blood pressure I take ramipril. For the high cholesterol I take rosuvastatin.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, and do you have any allergies to any medications at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. Um, any recent surgeries or hospitalizations? Or any reason for why, if like, if you were immobilized at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um no, I don't think so.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, any history of hospitalizations or surgeries at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, I had a cholecystectomy about, oh gosh, it's like, 12 years ago.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, and were there any complications at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. Um any family history of any lung conditions, heart conditions or cancers?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. Um currently, do you work at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No I, no I'm retired.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, and what's your living situation like?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I live with my husband, um in a condo.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. Um and are you, is your husband well? Does he have any symptoms?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh yeah, he's, he's been okay.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, that's good. Um, any kind of dust or mold, asbestos or any pets in your in your home?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. Do you smoke at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um I used to, but not anymore.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, and how long did you smoke for and how much would you smoke everyday?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, so I stopped about 20 years back. I smoked for about 25 years. I smoked about a pack a day.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I see, um, and do you use any recreational drugs like marijuana?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, I don't, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, and do you drink alcohol at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I, I'll have a glass of wine here and there.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, and um yeah, so those were kind of, all the questions that I had today. Do you have any concerns or questions?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, yeah like what, do you think I have COVID?

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah so, right now it's definitely something that's on everyone's mind. Um some of these symptoms, um the shortness of breath and fever, definitely can be COVID, and that's something that we are going to test you with, and that's something we test everyone with. Um, but because you're having shortness of breath, uh, we do need to make sure nothing else is going on as well. Uh you can potentially have pneumonia that's not COVID, it can be any other virus or bacteria, so we will get some blood work done, we'll get your temperature and all your vitals taken as well, um and then get a chest x-ray as well.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Okay.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And if it turns out at all that you have pneumonia, we'll just reassess and see if you need to stay in the hospital for longer, if you need any antibiotics within the hospital, or you can take them at home. So yeah, we'll do a full physical examination and do all those tests and then go from there.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Okay, that sounds great. Thank you.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: You're welcome. Um yeah, we'll be there with you shortly.
